settings.heading: About
settings.image_alt: Juno at the long table in the studio
settings.caption: The studio, Alfama
settings.text:
I'm Juno, a designer and illustrator in Lisbon. I make identities, books and drawings, mostly for people who make things themselves: potters, printers, a weaving workshop, a guesthouse. I draw first and design second, and most projects start as a page of ink. Before the studio I worked at Atelier Norte in Porto and Bureau Vale in Lisbon.

I take on a few commissions a year and teach a drawing class most springs.
